newsitem.title: USA: US March S&P 500 posts fresh record high at 785.35.
newsitem.headline: US March S&P 500 posts fresh record high at 785.35.

text.p: Jan 21 - U.S. March S&P 500s posted a new record high at 785.35 amid aggressive buying. Traders said the market had found its resilience again after initial nervousness on Greenspan comments. Bonds' drift back near unchanged further helped stocks, traders said. Traders said support and good buying at 776.00 propped the market on rally.
